record.title: Live trade outcomes — 3 closed positions (1W/2L, net $-0.7876) — 2026-08-21..2026-08-22
record.what: Every closed position from our own trading account since the last entry — across every sleeve that ever ran (whale-mirror and xs-reversal retired 2026-07-29 and earlier; cascade-fade is the live one), wins AND losses, indiscriminately. xs-reversal is market-neutral so it is reported per-BASKET (legs netted), not per-leg. Each settled on-chain on the public Hyperliquid account below; this is a signed, verifiable pointer to that on-chain truth (not a cherry-picked highlight reel).
